title: Wen Ho Lee espionage case

tellings.quote: There was a spy called Win Holi who was operating in the energy department in Liverour and Los Alamos.

plain: A spy named Wen Ho Lee was working inside the Energy Department at its weapons laboratories in Livermore and Los Alamos. So says John S. Herrington, a former Secretary of Energy, who tells Michels about the case as someone who was there in government at the time and brings Ed Meese, Reagan's attorney general, into the telling. He raises it as an example of how secrets leaked out of the nation's most guarded labs.
